profile_text.body:
Anysphere is the company behind Cursor, an AI-powered integrated development environment designed to assist software engineers with coding tasks. The company's website describes Cursor as built to make developers "extraordinarily productive" by using AI agents to turn ideas into code, with users able to delegate tasks ranging from targeted edits to fully autonomous agentic runs. The site quotes a user noting that some 40,000 engineers at their organization are now assisted by the tool, with productivity described as having increased considerably.

Cursor is categorized as a coding and developer tool and is Anysphere's sole tracked product. The site highlights features including autocomplete, AI-powered code suggestions, and a bring-your-own-model option, with keyboard shortcuts such as Cmd+K for scoped edits and a full autonomy mode for broader agentic operation. The held facts include a note that Cursor has been associated with source-code exposure concerns, though no litigation is recorded in the available data.
